declared: 2026-10-24, before any 8DNA or reference render of these scenes
revision_before_any_render: 2026-10-24: after an independent code review and a CPU-only synthetic test of the evaluation, and before any render of these scenes: E1 in-envelope box moved onto the seal's cuboid pedestal (the OBJ contains a closed pedestal filling the AABB footprint up to y = 0.1218), E1 size order [0.18, 0.12]; E2 T0 moved onto the flat table top; E3 bunny albedo grid moved with the instance; receivers eroded by one pixel; paired-seed noise estimators; SSIM defined; non-finite handling; ladder noise-floor correction; VCallRecord decided from render time; parameter check in every rendering process; a dry pass of every stage gates the real run
revision_during_run: 2026-10-25: the refs stage hung for about 4 h at its first E2 direct-only reference (a 512^2 x 64-spp launch = 16.7 M lanes exhausted the 12 GB GPU; DrJit flushed its cache and the process then spun on one CPU core with the GPU idle). No direct-only reference existed. Direct-only references now use the E2 reference chunk (16, i.e. 4.2 M lanes, like every other launch); render() refuses launches above 4.2 M lanes, flushes DrJit's cache before each render and logs progress every 60 s. The run resumed from the refs stage; the 18 finished references (all E1, E2 T0 red/black) were reused after their sidecars matched. No measured value had been looked at.
question: What can a fixed, released 8DNA asset recover after a rigid edit of another object in its scene, when the rest of the scene is ordinary path-traced geometry, and at what fidelity, transport coverage and cost?
scope_note: Official 8DNA assets in their own Mitsuba scenes, plus an explicit red box (and in E3 a second learned asset). This is NOT the ReST-GI Lego edit and its numbers are not comparable with Lego/Cycles results. The Lego edit is analysed separately at code/geometry level (box inside the Lego AABB and convex hull at T0 and T1).

host.machine: LabServer63 (RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB) only; every render of this protocol, references included, on this one machine
host.start_condition: after the WL42 FNTO server chain: after_train.status starts with 'done' and a2_refs.status starts with 'done', and no GPU compute process for 10 minutes (user decision 2026-10-24: run after FNTO, on the server); if either FNTO status reads 'failed', the chain stops with status 'blocked' and does not start
host.dry_pass: before the real stages, every stage runs at 32x32 and <= 16 spp into a separate folder (never evidence); any failure stops the chain
host.yield_rule: before every render, wait while another process holds more than 500 MiB of GPU memory
host.environment: upstream pins: python 3.10, torch 2.3.1+cu121, mitsuba 3.5.1, drjit 0.4.6, variant cuda_ad_rgb; ~/NeuralShaderDemo/external/8dna26 at 4a2157ca24e506c5ac0831f27d656ecc50a64f07, unmodified
host.optix_fix: source server/mi_env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH = 595.71.05 OptiX user-space libraries); every process ends with os._exit after writing outputs (DrJit 0.4.6 jit_shutdown leak-report crash)
host.jit_flags: LoopRecord False (demo notebook, all renders). VCallRecord False (demo notebook) unless the launch-size probe's 4-spp renders (seal 256^2, teaset 512^2; timed after model load) take more than 600 s or the probe does not finish within 1200 s; then True (WL21: on/off agree to 1.1e-5). A False probe that fails for another reason fails stage 0. The value used is recorded.

learned_state.checkpoints: released seal.ckpt, teaset.ckpt, bunny.ckpt; sha256 recorded; no training, no fine-tuning, no parameter update anywhere in this protocol
learned_state.parameter_check: sha256 of every asset model's state_dict before the first and after the last render of every rendering process (static, neural, ladder, cost); a mismatch stops the chain

integrators.neural: neuralpath, max_depth 10, rr_depth 5 (demo notebook); one asset_<instance id> key per learned asset; integrator.is_prepared reset for every new scene and asset lanes counted to prove every learned asset was active
integrators.reference_volume: volpath (C++), max_depth -1, rr_depth 5, if stage 0 shows it matches the scenes' own prbvolpath (MSE(volpath, prbvolpath_A) <= 1.5 x MSE(prbvolpath_A, prbvolpath_B), display space, seal scene2 128^2, 2048 spp each); otherwise prbvolpath
integrators.reference_surface: path (C++), max_depth -1, rr_depth 5, under the same rule against the scene's prb (teaset 128^2, 2048 spp)

display: d(x) = clamp(max(x,0)^(1/2.2), 0, 1) (demo notebook / ednalib); PSNR = -10 log10(mean display MSE); SSIM on d(x): Gaussian window 11x11, sigma 1.5, K1 0.01, K2 0.03, mean over channels and pixels; HDR metrics: linear relMSE (x-r)^2/(r^2+1e-2) and logL1 |log1p(x)-log1p(r)|

box.shape: Mitsuba cube (axis aligned), side s, diffuse, rests on the support below it with a 2 mm gap (support height from 5x5 downward rays in the box-absent scene)

variants.absent: no box; one scene shared by all states of an experiment

geometry_validity.out_of_envelope: box AABB disjoint from the asset AABB with clearance >= 0.02
geometry_validity.in_envelope: box AABB entirely inside the asset AABB; inset 10 mm from the asset AABB's x and z faces
geometry_validity.no_intersection: no hit along all 28 corner-to-corner segments of the box (12 edges, 12 face diagonals, 4 space diagonals) in the box-absent scene, and no asset vertex inside the box grown by 1 mm
geometry_validity.support: the 25 footprint rays must hit the declared support with height spread < 0.02 (E1 T0/T1_out: floor; E1 T1_in: the seal instance, i.e. the top face of its pedestal; E2 T0/T1_out: table; E2 T1_in: the teaset instance, i.e. the tray)
geometry_validity.in_envelope_bottom: bottom = max(rest height, asset AABB min y + 0.002)
geometry_validity.if_invalid: design stage stops; no automatic redesign except the declared size/placement orders below

B_static.what: official demonstrations on the server's official environment
B_static.comparison: each machine against its own references only (WL21/WL22 PC rows: seal 26.61 dB, teaset 29.20 dB wavefront); cross-machine values are reported side by side, never pooled

E3_seal_bunny.check: stage 0: identity vs translated bunny instance and camera under the bunny's distant envmap, same seeds: display MSE <= 0.1 x the MSE between two seeds
E3_seal_bunny.role: descriptive: learned-asset to learned-asset free-space coupling under an edit; no box

seeds.neural_main: 0 + chunk index (same in every state and variant: paired random numbers)
seeds.pairing_note: references of every state and variant share the A (and B) seeds, so differences between states are paired; noise of differences is estimated from A-B differences, not assumed independent

regions.classes: per pixel from one pixel-centre camera ray per scene: asset instance, other learned asset, box, support (floor/table/wall), light, background
regions.receivers: for a state pair (T0, Tx): pixels whose class is the (stationary) asset in T0, Tx and the absent scene after eroding each of these asset masks by one pixel (3x3), so pixels whose box-filter footprint can touch the box or another class are excluded
regions.A_changed: receiver pixels with max over RGB of |box5(d(G_Tx)) - box5(d(G_T0))| > max(2 tau, 4 sigma), tau = 0.005, sigma = std over the receivers of box5[(d(A_Tx) - d(A_T0)) - (d(B_Tx) - d(B_T0))] / 2
regions.G: mean of reference A and B

metrics.static: per state and variant: full-frame display PSNR/SSIM; asset-pixel (eroded) display MAE, linear relMSE, logL1; noise floors neural main vs repeat and reference A vs B
metrics.change: dG = G(Tx) - G(T0), dN = N(Tx) - N(T0) (main seeds), linear RGB on receivers: gain = <dN,dG>/<dG,dG>, Pearson corr, rel_err = ||dN-dG||/||dG||; sign agreement where |lum dG| > 3 sigma_lum
metrics.noise: reference noise of dG: rms of ((A_Tx - A_T0) - (B_Tx - B_T0))/2; neural noise of dN: rms of (dN_main - dN_repeat)/sqrt(2); sigma_lum: the reference estimator on luminance
metrics.recovery: on A_changed, display MSE: R = (E_stale - E_upd)/(E_stale - E_static); E_stale = MSE(N_T0, G_Tx), E_upd = MSE(N_Tx, G_Tx), E_static = MSE(N_T0, G_T0); undefined if E_stale - E_static <= 0; F = E_stale/E_upd
metrics.families: occlusion dX_occ = X_black(Tx) - X_absent; reflection dX_refl = X_red(Tx) - X_black(Tx); gain/corr/rel_err of dN vs dG on the eroded asset receivers of (Tx, absent); E2 also splits the reference occlusion change into direct (max_depth 2) and indirect (rest)
metrics.signal_gate: a change is classified only if rms(dG) > 3 x its reference noise and > 3 x its neural noise, both on the same receivers
metrics.classification: INVALID_NONFINITE if any receiver pixel of an input is non-finite or a metric is non-finite; NOISE_LIMITED if the signal gate fails; TRACKED if gain in [0.8,1.25], corr >= 0.8 and (where defined) R >= 0.8; NOT_TRACKED if gain < 0.4 or gain > 2.0 or corr < 0.5 (an undefined corr counts as 0) or R < 0.4; otherwise PARTIAL. Descriptive labels for this baseline only; not a verdict on FNTO.

code_derived_hypotheses.H1: an edit whose box stays outside the asset AABB is tracked (TRACKED) with zero parameter updates, because every segment outside the AABB is path traced in the current scene
code_derived_hypotheses.H2: an edit that places the box inside the asset AABB is not fully tracked: learned internal paths, learned NEE from the AABB exit and continuation from the exit ignore the box (code audit A4 case b)
code_derived_hypotheses.H3: learned-to-learned asset coupling (E3) is path traced and tracked like H1

cost.per_render: wall time with CUDA sync (warm: one discarded warm-up render per process), torch peak allocated, process GPU memory (nvidia-smi max), non-finite pixel count
cost.queries: one instrumented 4-spp render per scene: learned lanes in eval_asset and sample_asset, rays (lanes x calls) of scene.ray_intersect / ray_intersect_preliminary / ray_test / sample_emitter_direction in the Python neural integrator; reported per pixel per spp
cost.edit_update: one scene, box moved T0 <-> T1_out by mi.traverse vertex updates, 10 alternating params.update() calls: the declared value is the median of the 5 T0 -> T1 updates; then a full render at the protocol spp, compared with the separately loaded T1_out scene at the same seeds; no learned state exists to update
cost.matched_quality: E1 T1_out and E2 T1_out, variant red: neural spp {16,64,256,1024} and reference spp {16,64,256,1024,4096}; display MSE and linear relMSE vs G on the full frame and on the receivers of (T0, T1_out) against warm wall time; each error is floor-corrected by subtracting G's own error 0.25 x error(A, B) on the same pixels (raw values reported too); equal-error and equal-time ratios by log-log interpolation, beyond the ladder by MSE ~ 1/time
cost.offline: no training in this protocol; cite paper Tab. 3 (1.78 h surface, 2.23 h volumetric pre-bake) and WL27 (teaset re-bake 1.76 h on the RTX 5080)
